front.title: International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) URN Definition

abstract.t: The International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) is a standard numbering system for the unique and international identification of audiovisual works. This document is the definition of the formal Uniform Resource Name (URN) Namespace Identifier (NID) for ISAN.

section.name: Status of This Memo
section.t: This memo provides information for the Internet community. It does not specify an Internet standard of any kind. Distribution of this memo is unlimited.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: This document is the definition of the formal Uniform Resource Name (URN) Namespace Identifier (NID) for ISAN.

dl.dd: ISAN, its syntax, uses and its processes are defined in .
Uniqueness is guaranteed by the ISAN International Agency that issues the numbers. Numbers are not re-assigned.
Persistence is guaranteed by ISO Registration Authority processes and contracts with the ISAN International Agency.

The details of the assignment process are defined from time to time by the ISAN International Agency. However, in general, any approved entity can request an ISAN number by providing the required metadata information and paying the registration fee. The ISAN International Agency may delegate to regional or market-based Registration Agencies for portions of the registration process.

ISAN numbers are resolved by a direct or indirect lookup with the ISAN International Agency. At this writing, a non-commercial, manual system is available online at . The resolution procedures may be modified from time to time by the ISAN International Agency.
The ISAN-NSS is unique by the nature of the ISAN International Agency's number management. The ISAN-NSS is case-insensitive. Upper and lower case characters are treated as identical.
No special considerations. The syntax is fully conformant with .
The check digits provide syntax integrity. Lookup is via online and offline services provided by the ISAN International Agency.

section.t: The following syntax specification uses an augmented Backus-Naur Form (BNF) and elements defined in the URN Syntax . This syntax here is derived from the syntax definition in , constrained to prohibit the space character as a separator.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: This document only defines the syntax and resolution authority for the ISAN numbers. Details of the resolution process and the security of the assignment and resolution system processes are defined external to this document by the ISAN International Agency and thus outside the scope of this document.

section.name: Namespace Considerations
section.t: ISAN is an external numbering system managed by an external agency established by ISO. While URN namespaces may exist for which any generic numbering system can be encoded, there is currently no direct encoding for ISAN. An example of such a namespace is the MPEG-21 system.
ISAN numbers are reserved for use in identifying audiovisual works for which there is a moving visual component, or components related to such a work (e.g. subtitling track).

section.name: Community Considerations
section.t: The primary registrants for ISAN numbers are the producers and studios of audiovisual works (movies and television shows). While the system is not constrained to "major" works (any bona fide entity can register any work), the primary benefits of its use come from works that are widely distributed. The users of the ISAN system range from the studios themselves to film and video archives and libraries, rights administrators, program guide services, and audience measurement services. Its potential for use in the Internet community is as an identifier for streaming media.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: This document defines a URN NID registration that is to be entered into the IANA registry of URN NIDs. It specifically requests the NID, "ISAN".
